newsitem.title: USA: Nortech Forest names Sam Garst as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Nortech Forest names Sam Garst as CEO.

text.p: Nortech Forest Products Inc said Monday it appointed Sam Garst as chief executive officer and a director, following the resignation of CEO and board member Thomas de Petra.
Chairman Robert Gilbertson said the management change will help position the company's proprietary animal repellent technology in the retail garden, professional horticultural and forestry markets.
Nortech said Garst has made a significant investment in the company, which is part of a private placement equity raised by Nortech in the past 90 days.

Gilbertson said the additional equity raised will go to increase the market profile of Nortech's leading product, Tree Guard brand deer repellent and assure development of a companion rabbit repellent for launch in the fall of 1997.
Garst previously worked as a strategic manager for the garden and professional products division of Zeneca Group Plc in the United Kingdom.
